name: octoplan-claude
description: Work-stream planning and supervised delivery for Octopad, for Claude Code. One session plans a work stream into detailed, ordered, self-contained tasks, shows the finished plan with every protected effect disclosed in plain words, asks one delivery-mode question — Full autonomy, Checkpoints, or Step-by-step — and on that answer supervises the delivery of the plan. Codex runs its own Octoplan distribution.
